positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a financial feature for processing invoice to Workday, which resulted an annual savings of $300,000 and a processing time reduction of 50%.
- Successfully completed the Price Data Model Migration to abstract Price data to highly consistent and securely consumed by other teams. 
- Established data pipeline to Snowflake and workflow for reimbursement by using Kafka, and PostgreSQL.
- Created and enhanced the UI of financial dashboards, for the ease of operation teams to use. 
- Utilized Datadog, Kibana, and ElasticSearch to monitor traffic and logs to maintain services during on-call.
- Used Test Driven Development (TDD) to write extensible unit and integration tests, and performed A/B testing in both production and demo environments to quickly identify bugs and develop reliable service. 
- Updated and improved team documentation to enhance overall efficiency and knowledge.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · Python (Programming Language) · GraphQL · JavaScript · React.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · REST APIs · Amazon EKS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon SQS · TypeScript · Apache Kafka · Agile Methodologies · Apollo GraphQL

positions.title: Software Engineering Applications
positions.description:
Ezy Bitsy | https://github.com/hjlee0704/etsybitsy
Scaled an Express server for an ecommerce website application.
•	Following Agile SDLC, continousely integrated the server by using CircleCI and developed with Node.JS/Express, Postgres SQL, and AWS Infurstucture Services.
•	Optimized the service from 550 rps to 4250 rps using performance metric from K6 and New Relic by utilizing Redis Cache and Load balance with NGINX.

Tiddler | https://github.com/hjlee0704/tidder
Web application for reddit users to experience new layout.
•	Built CI/CD pipeline with GitHub, AWS CodeDeploy, and CodePipeline. 
•	Constructed user interface with React/Hooks to create a single page app.
•	Utilized Node.JS/Express to handle RESTful API, and stored user data with MongoDB/Mongoose 
•	Styled application with React Material UI.

Tripsy Jams | https://github.com/JAMS-Front-End-Capstone/review  
Travel platform for booking hotels and transportations.
•	Built reviews module of user interfaces and UI components with React/Hooks.
•	Developed RESTful API with Node.JS/Express to serve and manipulate large unstructured data in MongoDB/Mongoose by testing with React-Testing-Library/Jest and Enzyme.
•	Containerized Modules with Docker to deploy it on AWS EC2/S3/CloudFront.

positions.title: Software QA Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Proactively managed quality assurance (manually and using automated so|ware) for 100+ so|ware and hardware mobile devices, resulting in a 99.9% customer satisfaction rate.

• Streamlined testing processes by creating comprehensive test cases and maintaining thorough test documentation throughout the so|ware development life cycle (SDLC).
• Executed rigorous testing, including functional, regression, compatibility, and usability testing, and met 99.99% error-free test cases.
• By leveraging the Qualcomm Network Analysis tool, executed the test cases to validate the integrity and performance of 5G mobile device networks, ensuring the seamless operation of cutting-edge technology.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Mobile Networking · Selenium · Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) · QXDM · Virtual Private Network (VPN)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: · Maintained and updated MRO telescopes. As a research assistant, various tasks were performed. Such  as machining, circuit design, and implementing Python for the telescopes, and the guided cameras.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · NumPy · SOLIDWORKS · CNC Machine

positions.title: Boatswain mate
positions.description:
Directed and supervised eleven men team to maintain deck, small boat operations, navigation, and supervising each soldier to complete the tasks from a ship’s deck force or shore unit.  

Translated and reported in ROK-U.S. Joint Exercises for military operation simulations. Mediated between Korean and US military Units.
